job.title: Account Executive, Enterprise - Brazil
job.description:
Absolute Security is investing heavily in net new enterprise growth across Latin America. As an Enterprise Account Executive based in Brazil, you will own a greenfield territory and be accountable for closing new logo ARR within the country’s largest and most security-conscious organizations — including Fortune 1000 equivalents and regulated sectors like finance, telco, and government. You will be the tip of the spear for our expansion into the Brazilian enterprise market.

What You’ll Do

  • Territory Ownership: Manage a named patch based in São Paulo or a key metro area 
  • Pipeline Creation: Generate 4× pipeline coverage through strategic prospecting, executive outreach, and in-person events — relying on partners only to accelerate, not originate 
  • Deal Leadership: Lead Command of the Message cycles valued at $250K–$1M+ ARR, with sales cycles of 6–9 months and complex opportunities extending beyond 12 months 
  • Qualification Discipline: Apply MEDDPICC from discovery to close; no Champion, no deal 
  • Forecast Accuracy: Inspect and manage pipeline weekly via Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach; maintain commit accuracy within ±10% 
  • Executive Engagement: Build trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs, and board-level stakeholders; convert risk conversations into multi-year platform commitments 
  • Internal Orchestration: Lead cross-functional teams (Sales Engineering, Legal, Product, Channel), owning the deal from start to signature 
  • Overachievement: Meet or exceed new logo ARR goals; earn uncapped accelerators and President’s Club 
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers
  • Other duties as assigned by management

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity sales with proven $1M+ new logo deals 
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English 
  • Expert in MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, and enterprise deal strategy 
  • High energy, coachable, intellectually curious, and thrives in a high-accountability culture 
  • Based in São Paulo or willing to travel extensively across Brazil 

What Success Looks Like

  • 100%+ quota attainment in year one with 3–4 flagship enterprise wins 
  • Maintain 4× pipeline coverage and forecast within ±5% 
  • Drive referenceable deals with documented expansion potential 
  • Recognized internally for clean forecasting, champion building, and competitive wins 

Rewards  

  • Lucrative OTE with no cap and aggressive accelerators 
  • High visibility to ELT and Board — LATAM is a top FY26 priority 
  • Platform protects 21,000+ customers worldwide 
  • Force Management enablement, elite sales tech stack, and seller-first culture 

Why Work For Us:

You’re resilient and passionate about securing the Work from Anywhere era. So are we.   

We’re in search of the best and the brightest – everyone from innovators, sellers and marketers to financers, operators and especially customer relationship managers – we’re looking for top tier talent to help us shape the next decade of security, drive innovation that enables customers with truly disruptive solutions and are dedicated to making a meaningful difference.  

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington with international offices in Vancouver - BC, Austin - TX, Boulder - CO, Ankeny – IA, Reading - UK and Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam, Absolute Security accelerates customers’ shift to work-from-anywhere through the industry’s first self-healing Zero Trust platform, ensuring maximum security and uncompromised productivity. Only Absolute is embedded in more than half a billion devices, offering a permanent digital connection that intelligently and dynamically applies visibility, control and self-healing capabilities to endpoints, applications, and network access to ensure their cyber resilience tailored for distributed workforces.

Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Absolute currently serves approximately 16,000 customers with more than 13 million activated endpoints globally. G2 recognized Absolute as a Leader in the Winter 2022 Endpoint Management and Zero Trust Networking Grid Reports, reflecting our continued customer satisfaction across product lines. To learn more about Absolute, visit our website at www.absolute.com or visit our YouTube channel.

job.title: Order Management Administrator
job.description:
This is a full-time temporary role covering a 14-month maternity leave. We are open to remote candidates, ideally based in BC or Alberta. 

Role Overview:  

  • Fulfill software license orders using Salesforce and NetSuite 
  • Follow stated department Service Level Agreements for order fulfillment 
  • Respond to requests from internal and external customers in a helpful, solutions-oriented manner, escalating to the Team Lead or Director of Order Management when a request is difficult to resolve 
  • Maintain and keep current business process documents for customers on the Order Management Confluence and Asana platforms 
  • Actively participate, train, and become proficient in executing new order management processes as they arise 

What You’ll Do:  

  • Manual Order Entry (5% of orders): Convert orders sent by Trading Partners via email, PDF, spreadsheet, or other formats into templated reports for upload into the Order Management system for booking 
  • Correctly assigning orders to customer accounts in Salesforce to provision licenses for the use of the customer 
  • [ ] Invoicing of all orders approved and ready for invoicing 
  • Credit notes on orders as required 
  • Order moves for either incorrectly assigned orders or as instructed by Sales 
  • Ensure approved orders match the correct Service Start date, researching and correcting discrepancies with assistance from other departments as needed 
  • Troubleshoot issues such as order loading errors, approval of orders due to technicalities of accounts not yet set up, and any other issues that can result in delays to order approval 
  • Coverage during team member absences whether that be due to unforeseen unavailability or planned vacation 
  • Work extra hours at month-end, quarter-end, or during special circumstances affecting booking requirements or customer satisfaction. The last two weeks of March, June, September, and December are vacation blackout periods to ensure all orders are booked. 
  • Support Order Management transactions such as Order Loading, Order Approval, Account Assignment, Credit Notes, Buyback, and Annual Payment scenarios 
  • Follow up with Trading Partners if missing end-user information is required to book orders 
  • Collaborate with the Global Sales Operations when required to get accounts set up or revised 
  • Work on Consumer reporting as assigned 
  • Work with inter-company departments such as Channel or Sales to resolve issues affecting order booking, even when beyond the scope of outlined tasks, providing subject matter expertise as needed 
  • Attend Order Management or other internal department meetings to be updated with the information needed to complete current or new tasks or help resolve issues 
  • Utilize the Helpdesk Process to resolve Order Management System Issues 
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers 
  • Take on other projects or tasks as required by the department 

What You’ll Bring:  

  • Five years of experience in an Order Management environment, with an understanding of booking orders in a Term, Billing-in-Arrears, Invoicing, and Credit/Debit transactional environment 
  • Strong ability to learn variations of standard billing methods 
  • Strong team player, willing to support teammates at all levels to help the department meet its objectives — including training others and contributing new ideas for improving processes 
  • Proficiency in Excel (Pivot Tables, Filter, Sort), as many tasks require managing order data files before reviewing them in Salesforce and NetSuite 
  • Strong attention to detail — as a security company, correctly assigning orders to the proper customer accounts is essential

job.title: Partner Program Manager
job.description:
Partner Program Manager

Absolute Security is seeking a Partner Program Manager to join our Global Channel Operations team. This role will be responsible for the ongoing development, operationalization, and management of Absolute's global partner program. The ideal candidate will combine strong program management skills, channel expertise, operational rigor, and cross-functional leadership to help drive partner engagement, accountability, and revenue growth. 

Reporting to the AVP, Global Channel Operations, this position will serve as a key liaison across Channel Sales, Marketing, Revenue Enablement, Finance, Operations, and other business functions to ensure our partner ecosystem is equipped, engaged, and positioned for success. 

Responsibilities Include: 

  • Support the development, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Absolute's global partner program.
  • Help build and maintain a world-class global partner program that enables partner growth and supports accelerated partner-generated ARR.
  • Ensure consistent execution of partner program policies, processes, benefits, and requirements across regions.
  • Facilitate partner tiering and leveling initiatives and help ensure partners and internal stakeholders remain aligned to program requirements and benefits.
  • Coordinate quarterly and annual partner performance reviews, business reviews, and partner business planning activities.
  • Support the creation of governance, measurement, and accountability processes that help ensure both Absolute and its partners deliver against shared commitments and objectives.
  • Measure partner engagement, performance, and program effectiveness through reporting, analytics, and KPI tracking.
  • Support partner onboarding processes and ongoing program administration.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner experience, operational efficiency, and program scalability.
  • Serve as the primary owner of partner-facing content within the Partner Portal.
  • Curate, organize, and maintain core partner content, channel-ready assets, sales plays, promotions, and program information.
  • Ensure partner-facing content remains current, relevant, and globally consistent.
  • Manage localization requirements and regional variations where appropriate.
  • Coordinate with Marketing, Creative Services, Revenue Enablement, Product Marketing, and Channel Sales teams to source, update, and publish partner-facing materials.
  • Facilitate publication and maintenance of partner dashboards and other partner resources.
  • Partner with Revenue Enablement and other stakeholders to ensure training, certification, and learning content is current, accessible, and relevant to partners.
  • Convert internal enablement resources and learning tracks into channel-ready content.
  • Maintain partner training and certification resources within the Partner Portal.
  • Ensure partners have access to the tools, content, and educational resources needed to successfully position and sell Absolute solutions.
  • Support the planning and execution of Partner Advisory Board and Partner Summit programs.
  • Coordinate partner communications related to program updates, initiatives, promotions, training, and enablement activities.
  • Assist in the development and management of partner engagement initiatives, including partner journey automation and gamification programs.
  • Act as a central liaison across Channel Sales, Marketing, Revenue Enablement, Finance, Operations, and other functional teams.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders to support program execution and partner success.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across the organization to ensure successful implementation of partner initiatives.
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers.
  • Other duties as assigned by management. 

Future responsibilities may include administration of partner renewal and incumbency protection programs, incentive and MDF programs, Allbound platform administration, and expanded partner automation and analytics capabilities. 

What You Need: 

  • 5+ years of experience in channel operations, partner programs, channel enablement, partner success, or related program management roles.
  • Experience working within a software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or technology company.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or managing partner programs and partner-facing initiatives.
  • Strong program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience working cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, and Finance teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and successfully navigate cross-functional environments.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to leverage data to support decision-making and program improvements.
  • Experience managing partner portals, partner enablement platforms, learning management systems, or similar technologies is preferred.
  • Experience with partner onboarding, partner performance management, tiering programs, business planning, or partner governance is highly desirable.
  • Experience within cybersecurity or endpoint security markets is preferred.
  • Experience working in a global organization is an asset. 

The successful candidate will help operationalize and scale Absolute's partner ecosystem, improve partner engagement and accountability, reduce operational barriers to growth, and contribute to increased partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and ARR growth. This individual will thrive in a collaborative environment, demonstrate strong initiative, and bring a passion for building programs that create measurable business impact.

job.title: Business Development Representative, Enterprise
job.description:
In this Business Development Representative role, you will be the front line to our Enterprise prospects, driving interest in Absolute and initiating the sales cycle. In this role, you will collaborate with our Marketing and Account Executive teams to research and build a pipeline in new and existing accounts. You will follow up on both inbound and outbound leads across North America. Your exceptional communication and critical thinking skills will enable you to quickly assess opportunities and secure meetings with key account personas for our Account Executives. This role will be primarily focused on top-of-funnel activities — building relationships, opening doors, and generating interest among executive-level stakeholders. In addition, this individual will support the sales team with strategic sales initiatives and account coordination to help drive conversion and pipeline progression

  • Generate and qualify leads, identifying prospects genuinely interested in our cybersecurity solutions 
  • Prioritize and research prospects, understanding their current IT situation, challenges, and needs 
  • Engage prospective clients via phone, email, and social media (LinkedIn) to convey Absolute’s unique value propositions 
  • Schedule qualified meetings for Sales through cold calling and strategic outreach, converting them into pipeline opportunities 
  • Build and prioritize strategic account lists within a defined segment 
  • Partner with sales leadership to develop territory plans and target account strategies 
  • Support sales cycles with research, call prep, and occasional participation in follow-up activities or RFP coordination 
  • Build and maintain a working knowledge of target industry trends, pain points, and buyer personas 
  • Foster alignment and positive partnerships with internal Field Sales and Marketing teams. 
  • Assist in sales campaigns, ABM outreach, and special initiatives as needed 
  • Participate in virtual and/or in-person events as needed 
  • Utilize our CRM system (Salesforce) to log activity and lead conversion data for business transparency 
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers
  • Other duties as assigned by management

What You’ll Bring :  

  • Previous business development experience (3 years preferred) with a proven track record of consistently opening qualified opportunities that lead to revenue. 
  • Resilience and a fearless approach to challenges, particularly in objection handling 
  • Strong communication skills for effective interaction with customers, prospects, and team members 
  • Ambitious individuals eager to learn and contribute significantly to the business's continued success
